class.name: OcgSelectmgrSensitiveentityset
class.brief_description: This class is used to store all calculated sensitive entities of one selectable object. It provides an interface for building BVH tree which is used to speed-up the performance of searching for overlap among sensitives of one selectable object
class.description: ! This class is used to store all calculated sensitive entities of one selectable object. ! It provides an interface for building BVH tree which is used to speed-up ! the performance of searching for overlap among sensitives of one selectable object

method.name: Append_1
method.description: Adds new entity to the set and marks BVH tree for rebuild

method.name: Append_2
method.description: Adds every entity of selection theSelection to the set and marks BVH tree for rebuild

method.name: Remove
method.description: Removes every entity of selection theSelection from the set and marks BVH tree for rebuild

method.name: Box
method.description: Returns bounding box of entity with index theIdx

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns geometry center of sensitive entity index theIdx along the given axis theAxis

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps items with indexes theIdx1 and theIdx2

method.name: GetSensitiveById
method.description: Returns the entity with index theIndex in the set
